setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays the four-step phrase (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) through a device with MIDI CCs, at 90 BPM with Rate /1, so one step lasts a sixth of a second. PARAMS is open on the device's CC 1 control at its stored value, 63, set in PARAMS > MOSAIC. CC 1 is not assigned to a Trig params slot yet, and parameter slides are off.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K1 to leave PARAMS. Turn E1 to Channel tasks, choose Trig params with E2 and press K3, then press K2 and turn E3 to CC 1 in the parameter list.
steps.title: Find CC 1

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign CC 1 and K2 to return. Slot 1 now reads 63, the stored value, with no marker in its corner, because no step has a lock for it yet.
steps.title: Assign CC 1 to the slot

steps.caption: Hold step 1 at (1,4) and turn E3 to 24. Slot 1 shows 24 with an L in its corner while the step is held, so this step now has its own value for CC 1. Release the step.
steps.title: Lock step 1 to 24

steps.caption: Hold step 3 at (3,4) and turn E3 to 96. Slot 1 shows 96 with the L. Release the step. Steps 1 and 3 now carry different CC 1 values, two steps apart.
steps.title: Lock step 3 to 96

steps.caption: With no step held, press K3. Slot 1 reads 63 again and gains an S in its corner, so every lock of CC 1 slides toward the next one.
steps.title: Turn slides on for the parameter

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), let two loops play, then tap it again to stop. In the MIDI strip, CC 1 starts at 24 on step 1 and climbs in equal steps of 12, about every 56 ms: 36, 48, 60, 72, 84, reaching 96 as step 3's note starts. The glide fills the two steps between the locks.
steps.title: Play and watch the glide

steps.caption: Press K1 to open PARAMS. CC 1 still shows its stored value, 63: playback never changes the setting you stored, so the glide exists only in the CC messages that were sent.
steps.title: The device setting does not change
